brief: One complete requirement: None, one registered present status/Primed with Self/Target, or one strict HP/MP percentage comparison with Self/Target. Native execution timing is separate and finite.

sharedPolicy.legacyInterpreter: Historical captures retain their exact prior definitions; only new versions opt into requirementMode simple.
sharedPolicy.preservation: All names, pairs, costs, effects, target geometry, cooldowns, limits, assets and unlocks stay unchanged except one strict Aether Nova effect requirement and necessary Self causal target bindings.
sharedPolicy.effectEligibility: No Resonance has effect-level conditions. Existing positive singleton effect gates stay unchanged. Field Remedy and Dawn’s Oath historical Any-of-nine standard Cleanse eligibility stays unchanged outside this cohort.
